user.title: TV Sitter
user.description: Enter the MQTT topic prefix configured in the app on your TV.

pair.title: Pair with the TV
pair.description: {name} is showing a six-digit PIN. Type it here. It is valid for five minutes, and you get five attempts.

data_description.topic_prefix: No wildcards. This is sent to the TV, so both halves end up using the same one.

broker.name: Broker settings
broker.description: Taken from your MQTT integration. Leave the account blank to reuse the one Home Assistant already connects with, or fill it in to give this TV its own.

data_description.host: The address as the TV sees it. Home Assistant reaches the Mosquitto add-on by a name that only works inside Home Assistant, so this is filled in with something the TV can actually reach.

error.invalid_topic_prefix: The prefix must not be empty or contain + or # characters.
error.wrong_pin: That is not the PIN on the screen.
error.wrong_pin_attempts: That is not the PIN on the screen. {attempts} attempts left.
error.expired: The PIN has expired. Open TV Sitter on the TV for a new one.
error.no_attempts_left: Too many wrong attempts. Open TV Sitter on the TV for a new PIN.
error.already_used: That PIN has already been used.
error.pairing_not_active: The TV is not waiting to be paired. Open TV Sitter on it first.
error.cannot_connect: The TV did not answer. Check that it is on and still showing the PIN.
error.unexpected_response: Something other than TV Sitter answered on that port.
error.unknown: Pairing failed, and the TV did not say why.

abort.not_tvsitter: That device is not running TV Sitter.
abort.no_broker: Home Assistant could not work out a broker address to give the TV. Enter the broker settings by hand.
abort.mqtt_unavailable: TV Sitter talks to the TV over MQTT. Set up the MQTT integration first, then add this one.
abort.updated_existing: The TV was already configured. Its entry has been updated and it is now paired.

grant_time.name: Grant time
grant_time.description: Gives the child the time they asked for.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How much time to add to today's budget.

req_id.name: Request
req_id.description: Which request is being answered. Leave empty to answer the most recent one.

deny_time.name: Deny time
deny_time.description: Refuses, which the TV shows on screen.

req_id.name: Request
req_id.description: Which request is being answered. Leave empty to answer the most recent one.
